generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.
Tenders from Consortium are not acceptable
Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government Of Karnataka.

The Tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka Public Procurement Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches
EMD payments through e-payment mode shall be as single transaction and payment made in part are liable for rejection.

The Bidder shall scan the Bank Guarantee towards EMD and upload the same in the prescribed format in the Karnataka Public Procurement Portal to enable the owner for verification of EMD BG at the time of opening of Techno Commercial Bid, failing which the offer will be rejected. Also, the Bidder shall ensure that the Bank Guarantee towards EMD shall be sent in original to the Chief Engineer, Electy., (T&P), KPTCL, Bengaluru, so as to reach after the last date of submission of bid & on or before the date & time notified for opening of Techno Commercial Bids, in a sealed cover, failing which their bid will not be opened.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of Karnataka Public Portal on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
Tenderer shall upload the legible documents only.
Bidder shall not take any deviations on the clauses listed in the No Deviation Certificate(Annexure-I)
All other terms and conditions as per Tender documents

itemList.description:
LINE SUPPLY PORTION
Total weight of the Towers - Mild Steel (excluding Bolts & nuts)

Total weight of the Towers - High Tensile Steel
(excluding Bolts & nuts)
Total weight of the Towers- Bolts, nuts & washers

Tower Accessories 
a) Anti Climbing Devices (Set) as per specification - For 110kV DC Towers
b) Number Plates (1 No. per tower)
c) Caution Plates (1 No. per tower)
d) Circuit Plates
e) Phase Plates (Set of 3 Nos.)
f) Earth Bonds i) 300mm long
ii) 450mm long
g) Grounding of Tower with GI Pipe including the cost of GI Pipe, Gi wire etc.,

ACSR Conductor and Ground wire   
a) Lynx ACSR conductor(plain terrian)
b. Groundwire ACSR conductor

INSULATOR STRINGS :110kV lines:
NOTE: All the Insulator strings and hardware fittings quoted by the bidder shall be of the same type i.e. all the Insulator strings and hardware fittings shall be of Disc Insulators type OR all the Insulator strings and hardware fittings shall be of Polymeric Composite Insulators type OR  all the Insulator strings and hardware fittings shall be of Long rod insulator. Bidder shall quote either for Disc Insulators type OR for Composite Insulators type OR for Long rod insulator and not for all the types. A. Tension insulator strings consisting of any one of the following:
a. Insulator string consisting of 1X8nos. of 90kN Disc insulators Or b. Porcelain long rod insulator string equivalent to 1x8nos. of 90kN Disc insulators Or
c. Silicon rubber composite insulator equivalent to 1X8nos. of 90kN Disc insulators

B. Suspension insulator strings consisting of any one of the following: a. Insulator string consisting of 1X7nos. of 90kN Disc insulators Or b. Porcelain long rod insulator string equivalent to 1X7nos. of 90kN Disc insulators
Or c. Silicon rubber composite insulator equivalent to 1X7nos. of 90kN Disc insulators

Insulator Hardwares suitable for LYNX ACSR Condyctor:
NOTE: All the Insulator strings and hardware fittings quoted by the bidder shall be of the same type i.e. all the Insulator strings and hardware fittings shall be of Disc Insulators type OR all the Insulator strings and hardware fittings shall be of Polymeric Composite Insulators type OR  all the Insulator strings and hardware fittings shall be of Long rod insulator. 
Bidder shall quote either for Disc Insulators type OR for Composite Insulators type OR for Long rod insulator and not for all the types.
i) 110kV Clamps, Arcing Horns and Hardwares (Set)  suitable for Single Tension String using  8Nos. 90KN EMS, Disc Insulators
ii) 110kV Clamps, Arcing Horns and Hardwares (Set)  suitable for Double Tension String fittings using  2x8Nos. 90KN EMS, Disc Insulators
iii) 110kV Clamps, Arcing Horns and Hardwares (Set)  suitable for Single Suspension String fittings using 7Nos. of 90KN EMS, Disc Insulators
iv) 110kV Clamps, Arcing Horns and Hardwares (Set)  suitable for Double Suspension String fittings using  2x7Nos. of 90KN EMS, Disc Insulators

Accessories for ACSR Lynx conductor:
a) Mid Span Compression Joint
b) Preformed armour rod
c) Repair sleeves
d) P.G. Clamps
e) Vibration dampers

Hardware & Accessories for Ground Wire:
a) Mid Span Compression joint
b) Repair sleeves
c) P.G. Clamps
d) Tension clamps(bolted type)
e) Suspension clamps(bolted type)
SURVEY : Check survey & tower spotting. Note: As per UNI-SR 2023, Vol-VI and Tender Documents.a) Plain Terrain.

Installing insulator strings complete with necessary Hardwares, Installing and stringing of ACSR Lynx conductor including fixing of conductor accessories etc., Note :- The tenderers are required to quote the rates taking in to consideration the charges for loading and unloading of ACSR conductor, Insulators and Hardwares.

b) Installing and stringing of 7/3.15 mm earthwire including fixing of earth wire accessories and hardwares. Note :- The tenderers are required to quote the rates taking in to consideration the charges for loading and unloading of ACSR conductor / Ground Wire, Insulators and Hardwares.

Erection of Towers including tack welding, fixing of tower accessories , Anti Climbing Devices, earthing & technical specifications (The weight includes the wt. of std., tower & stubs, including bolts nuts and washers and supplying & fixing of Barbed wire as per drawings & technical specifications ) Note :- 1. The tenders are required to quote the rates taking in to consideration the charges for sorting of towers, loading, unloading, fixing of accessories, grounding, stub setting and tack welding and supplying & fixing of Barbed wire as per drawings & technical specifications. Rate to be quoted on per MT basis. 2. For split up details refer techno commercial sheet

Providing and laying in position plain cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite /trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. 
Mix 1:3:6 (M10) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, form work, centering & scaffolding and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. 
M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates For foundation

Steel Fabrication: Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification All other type of structures

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.
